confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Nepal's tourist-town pricing, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, and drink prices are less certain. July is monsoon and low season in Pokhara, so accommodation anchors reflect off-season rates. The FX observation came from search-result summaries of the RBA exchange-rate table; the table itself was not read directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Nepal's lakeside and tourist-town price levels, benchmarked against Kathmandu's Thamel and Lakeside tourist areas. Drink prices are set relative to local beer, with cocktails and wine about 2x beer.
